items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Eiji was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 13, 1999, by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Eiji has recorded frequently with some of the greatest pianists in jazz, including Hank Jones, Teddy Wilson and John Lewis and has also played alongside fellow clarinetists Woody Herman and Benny Goodman. He appeared at the 1978 Monterey Jazz Festival and has been a frequent guest with Bill Berry at West Coast festivals since then.
Eiji was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 13, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. At points in the interview Eiji was assisted by a translator.

We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Los Angeles and it’s a real pleasure for me to speak with Eiji Kitamura. Welcome. This is my first opportunity to speak with a musician from another country that is a great jazz player.
